title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsessive love for Salma leads to her separation from her son, Iqbal. Twenty years later, Iqbal strives to reunite with his mother.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Amid the ideological differences with his father Vijay, Ajay steps up to protect his family from Rajesh's, his brother-in-law's, evil intentions.

title: S 3
desc: A police officer is assigned to solve the murder of the police commissioner. However, when he stumbles across a criminal syndicate, he decides to put an end to their tyranny.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces and chart out an inspirational path of freedom against the despotic rulers.
